facts: A town of slightly above 5,000 residents
On the northwest side of Pohnpei, a high volcanic island ringed by a coral reef
worth_knowing: It was declared the capital in 1989 and is now the hub of the federal administration. Kolonia, the island's largest settlement, lies nearby to the northeast.
